resolvedPresentation.description: Let senior teachers test every public mission before it leaves the mountains, turning governance into clearer doctrine abroad.
resolvedPresentation.title: Abbot Examiners

resolvedPresentation.description: Under extreme chaos, the Realm can fold the false claim into its own doctrine. The power is real, and so is the corruption.
resolvedPresentation.title: Absorb the Shadow

resolvedPresentation.description: Survey sacred roads, close remote sites, and let foreign observers guess at the purpose.
resolvedPresentation.title: Seal the Remote Roads

resolvedPresentation.description: Select officials who claim detachment from fear, faction, and personal gain.
resolvedPresentation.title: Arhat Examinations

resolvedPresentation.description: Create the Arhat Administration and give oath-bound officials authority over the Realm's daily needs.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Arhats Take Office

resolvedPresentation.description: Transform the refuge into a Bodhisattva-led state.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Bodhisattva Accepts the Seal

resolvedPresentation.description: The Realm's officials and guards dismantle the rival shrine. Defilements rise, and its monasteries lose their freedom to oppose the Buddha.
resolvedPresentation.title: Break the False Mandala

resolvedPresentation.description: The Bodhisattva can become Buddha with §Y108§! Bodhi, §YFourth Dhyana§!, Defilements below §Y20§!, twelve successful teachings, and one teaching success during a major chaos crisis.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Unshaken Seat

resolvedPresentation.description: Define mercy as the prevention of every possible return.
resolvedPresentation.title: Compassion of Non-Return

resolvedPresentation.description: War and disorder threaten the mountain roads. The Realm may authorize force against the courts that remain outside its protection.
resolvedPresentation.title: Secure the High Passes

resolvedPresentation.description: Give the refuge a chamber before the chamber becomes a ministry. The assembly unlocks Dharma Teaching decisions, advances the Bodhisattva bhumi, grants major Political Power, and slightly reduces Chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: Convene Mountain Assembly

resolvedPresentation.description: Let senior abbots bind doctrine, teaching, and refuge law before the Arhat offices harden around them.
resolvedPresentation.title: Council of Abbots

resolvedPresentation.description: Map the roads used by grain, pilgrims, troops, and refugees. Each controlled state gains major infrastructure and a listening post, while the Realm gains Political Power and Mandala Reach.
resolvedPresentation.title: Pilgrimage Roads

resolvedPresentation.description: The pretender is brought before abbots, refugees, soldiers, and witnesses. The Realm answers the counterfeit mandala through teaching.
resolvedPresentation.title: Debate the Pretender

resolvedPresentation.description: Open the final ritual path only after Buddhahood and the first awakened power display. This does not authorize Final Silence by itself.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Last Wheel

resolvedPresentation.description: Only extreme disorder draws the Realm into eastern China. War aims open against the region, but each state must still be taken and integrated.
resolvedPresentation.title: Eastern China in Crisis

resolvedPresentation.description: Extend the Mandala toward western China. Greater influence abroad gives the Realm a path into Chinese affairs.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Eastern Pilgrimage Mandala

resolvedPresentation.description: Stabilize the Empty Seat aftermath in which the Buddha has passed beyond worldly action and the Realm remains to guard the wheel.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Empty Seat

resolvedPresentation.description: The false circle can be broken without blood by pushing its teachers beyond the passes. The danger leaves the capital and remains abroad.
resolvedPresentation.title: Exile the Echo

resolvedPresentation.description: Complete the inner rite with full Meditation Charge and end the last defilements before the final order.
resolvedPresentation.title: Extinction of Defilements

resolvedPresentation.description: Authorize the sealed doctrine only if every strict final condition has been met.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Last Authorization

resolvedPresentation.description: Make relief, judgement, and policy answer to the language of suffering.
resolvedPresentation.title: The First Doctrine of Suffering

resolvedPresentation.description: The first Dhyana offers attendants a calm discipline at the Bodhisattva's side.
resolvedPresentation.title: The First Quiet

resolvedPresentation.description: Open a fourth public teaching seat so envoys, translators, refugee teachers, and foreign witnesses can work without drowning each other out.
resolvedPresentation.title: Four Teaching Seats

resolvedPresentation.description: Let the final Dhyana milestone stand as a visible gate before the Unshaken Seat.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Fourth Quiet

resolvedPresentation.description: Fortify the approaches before the lowlands push their wars upward.
resolvedPresentation.title: Guard the High Passes

resolvedPresentation.description: Train the border guard to hold narrow roads, carry winter supply, and defend the shelter seal beyond the first valleys. Every controlled state receives forts and infrastructure, while the Realm gains Political Power, Command Power, army experience, and Mandala Reach.
resolvedPresentation.title: Guardians of the Pilgrim Passes

resolvedPresentation.description: Bring Tibet, Bhutan, Nepal, and Kham into one pilgrimage circuit when the Realm controls each of their mountain states.
resolvedPresentation.title: High Pass Pilgrimage Oaths

resolvedPresentation.description: Tie high-altitude research to the doctrine of prevention. The snow-line laboratories add three research slots and a large nuclear research program.
resolvedPresentation.title: Laboratories at the Snow Line

resolvedPresentation.description: Lamps burn along the mountain roads through the night. Arhat guards watch the valleys as the world beyond the passes falls silent.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Lamps Along the Road

resolvedPresentation.description: Choose restraint during ordinary peace. A sharp rise in global chaos closes this hopeful path.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Lamps Remain Lit

resolvedPresentation.description: Treat every uncontrolled frontier as evidence that suffering remains unadministered. The Realm gains political power, war support, Final Silence Pressure, and coercive chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Last Border Is a Wound

resolvedPresentation.description: Remove the final personal countersignature from doctrine.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Last Human Signature

resolvedPresentation.description: Open the pilgrimage route and send protection letters to nearby courts. If they refuse, the Arhats may seek a darker path through the pass.
resolvedPresentation.title: Letters beyond the Passes

resolvedPresentation.description: Write to governments whose people have forgotten why the war continues.
resolvedPresentation.title: Letters to the War-Tired

resolvedPresentation.description: Make impossible relief routes serve the Sangha Compact, threatened allies, and crisis corridors.
resolvedPresentation.title: Lotus Bridge

resolvedPresentation.description: The Mandala Bureau pressures nearby courts with relief, pilgrim roads, foreign observers, and limited protection claims.
resolvedPresentation.title: Border Courts of Mercy

resolvedPresentation.description: Build the administrative center that turns refuge work into state capacity.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Mandala Bureau

resolvedPresentation.description: Offer a coalition of refusal, mediation, and witnessed peace. Members take a peace vow, cannot declare offensive wars, and pursue acts of kindness that lower global chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: Mandala of Nations

resolvedPresentation.description: Expand the letters to nearby borderlands and prepare staged protection for states that enter by vow, occupation, or Arhat administration.
resolvedPresentation.title: Borderlands Petition the Mandala

resolvedPresentation.description: Bind the teaching route to proven missions: twelve successful teachings, with at least one success during major chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: Many Lamps, One Flame

resolvedPresentation.description: Give the final doctrine an office and force the authorization chamber to decide whether it can still be refused. The ministry expands nuclear facilities, prepares a limited thermonuclear payload set if the technology exists, and opens the authorization event.
resolvedPresentation.title: Ministry of Silence

resolvedPresentation.description: The Ministry of Vows binds every pledge and public duty to the Last Wheel.
resolvedPresentation.title: Ministry of Vows

resolvedPresentation.description: Bind construction, repair, and relief work to monastic labor vows. Controlled states receive civilian workshops and infrastructure.
resolvedPresentation.title: Monastery Workshops

resolvedPresentation.description: Issue artillery and rifle discipline to the guardians who hold the passes, with doctrine written around refusal and defense.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Bell and Rifle

resolvedPresentation.description: Build high-valley granaries and a supply hub so refugee roads, winter shelters, and defensive detachments can endure pressure.
resolvedPresentation.title: Mountain Granaries

resolvedPresentation.description: Turn the high valleys into a defensible refuge with roads, stores, and legal shelter seals.
resolvedPresentation.title: Mountain Refuge

resolvedPresentation.description: Give the refuge a wartime guardian who can command roads and garrisons while the seat remains under vow.
resolvedPresentation.title: Name a Protector Regent

resolvedPresentation.description: Foreign envoys may still arrive. The Realm no longer accepts ordinary pleas as policy.
resolvedPresentation.title: No More Peace Delegations

resolvedPresentation.description: Close the moral circle around every road, border, and launch cell. The Realm expands its reactor network, receives nuclear research acceleration, and raises Final Silence Pressure.
resolvedPresentation.title: No One Leaves the Mandala

resolvedPresentation.description: Pacification cannot be permitted to become conquest in ceremonial dress. The Realm gains political power and command authority while lowering Final Silence Pressure and chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: No Victory Parades

resolvedPresentation.description: The Realm claims the northern Indian valleys and gives the Arhats authority to protect them.
resolvedPresentation.title: Northern Indian Frontier

resolvedPresentation.description: Northern Indian states can enter the Mandala after the Realm takes control. Full integration requires a costly decision for each state.
resolvedPresentation.title: Northern Indian Petition Courts

resolvedPresentation.description: Turn simultaneous teaching presence into a planned anti-chaos doctrine, expanding relief and mission coordination after the power is shown.
resolvedPresentation.title: One Becomes Many

resolvedPresentation.description: Send Arhats into held valleys to judge local loyalty, guard storehouses, and restore order before resistance grows into war.
resolvedPresentation.title: Outer Valley Courts

resolvedPresentation.description: Treat force as the sharp instrument of mercy.
resolvedPresentation.title: Pacification Mandate

resolvedPresentation.description: If force is used, it must not become a parade. The focus unlocks pacification tools, adds the Pacification without Triumph idea, grants major Command Power and army experience, and raises Compassion Drift and Chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: Pacification without Triumph

resolvedPresentation.description: Prepare the Realm to cross walls, passes, rivers, and broken front lines only where chaos has made ordinary roads meaningless.
resolvedPresentation.title: Path through Walls

resolvedPresentation.description: Make the letters more persuasive when the Realm is stronger. Entry without war can ease Chaos, but coercive authority strains the vow.
resolvedPresentation.title: Protection by Petition

resolvedPresentation.description: Keep peacekeeping separate from possession.
resolvedPresentation.title: Peace without Ownership

resolvedPresentation.description: Let foreign witnesses enter the Realm under an oath of protection.
resolvedPresentation.title: Permit Foreign Pilgrimage

resolvedPresentation.description: Let the Pilgrim Assembly judge appeals from unstable neighbors before the compact decides whether refuge can become obligation.
resolvedPresentation.title: Pilgrim Refuge Courts

resolvedPresentation.description: Discipline the awakened powers so they remain instruments against chaos, not another language for ordinary war.
resolvedPresentation.title: Powers Are Not Toys

resolvedPresentation.description: Test whether Arhat office credentials still carry a burden.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Question of False Attainment

resolvedPresentation.description: Send letters and relief missions before the mandate becomes an ultimatum.
resolvedPresentation.title: Quiet Envoys

resolvedPresentation.description: Raise reserve detachments for road watches, avalanche lines, and narrow passes without turning protection into parade mobilization.
resolvedPresentation.title: Mountain Pass Detachments

resolvedPresentation.description: Bind nuclear and thermonuclear research to the final doctrine. The focus builds reactors and a nuclear facility, then grants major nuclear research bonuses. The arsenal must still be produced.
resolvedPresentation.title: Reactors and Prayer Wheels

resolvedPresentation.description: The Bodhisattva compares what the students have learned, what the armies have seen, and what the awakened eye reveals about suffering.
resolvedPresentation.title: Read the Pattern of Suffering

resolvedPresentation.description: Arm the passes without admitting that the refuge has become a fortress. Every controlled state receives new military and civilian industry.
resolvedPresentation.title: Refuge Foundries

resolvedPresentation.description: Reject imperial claims over suffering outside the mountains.
resolvedPresentation.title: Refusal of Empires

resolvedPresentation.description: Refuse to let apocalypse become a legitimate subject of policy.
resolvedPresentation.title: Refuse Final Debate

resolvedPresentation.description: Place the Protector Regent's officers at the roads where panic, supplies, and anti-chaos defense meet.
resolvedPresentation.title: Regent's Pass Watch

resolvedPresentation.description: Pacify territory through Arhat rule, relief, and imposed order. No celebration follows the rite.
resolvedPresentation.title: Release Through Administration

resolvedPresentation.description: Keep the fourth Dhyana alive after awakening, so practice continues to renew the Buddha's powers.
resolvedPresentation.title: Return to the Seat

resolvedPresentation.description: Replace emergency rule with courts that assign rights and duties. Core lands gain infrastructure and civil industry, while administered non-core lands gain compliance and lower resistance.
resolvedPresentation.title: Reform Civil Administration

resolvedPresentation.description: Roads that carry grain, refugees, envoys, and patrols must stop carrying rumor. The focus unlocks border-control decisions, adds the Border Quiet idea, and grants Political Power, Command Power, Mandala Reach, and Compassion Drift.
resolvedPresentation.title: Safe Roads for Pilgrims

resolvedPresentation.description: Turn shelter seals into state law. Protected communities provide manpower, stability, infrastructure, civil industry, Spiritual Legitimacy, Mandala Reach, and a small Chaos reduction.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Seal of Refuge

resolvedPresentation.description: Keep safe roads open through the valleys while Arhat guards guide families away from panicked armies.
resolvedPresentation.title: Seal the Roads from Panic

resolvedPresentation.description: Let pilgrims, guides, and witnesses hold a chamber that keeps foreign teaching and compact work close to the state.
resolvedPresentation.title: Seat the Pilgrim Assembly

resolvedPresentation.description: Prepare the emergency sky-seated display for capitals and sanctuaries threatened by chaos, never as an ordinary invasion tool.
resolvedPresentation.title: Seated in the Sky

resolvedPresentation.description: Carry the second Dhyana through the offices and the roads that feed them.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Second Quiet

resolvedPresentation.description: Turn renunciation into a new shelter system for those fleeing the wider collapse.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Second Refuge

resolvedPresentation.description: Send teachers and interpreters beyond the mountain roads. Dharma Teaching decisions become a public arm of the Realm.
resolvedPresentation.title: Send the First Envoys

resolvedPresentation.description: Issue doctrine that foreign ministries cannot render into normal state language.
resolvedPresentation.title: A Sermon without Translation

resolvedPresentation.description: Accept the villages nearest the passes into the refuge system.
resolvedPresentation.title: Shelter the Border Villages

resolvedPresentation.description: Give foreign exiles a legal place beneath the seal. Exile communities provide manpower, civil construction in every controlled state, Political Power, Spiritual Legitimacy, and a small Chaos reduction.
resolvedPresentation.title: Shelter the Exiles

resolvedPresentation.description: Prepare bunkers, anti-air, and winter shelters to protect lives under a defensive vow.
resolvedPresentation.title: Fortress Without Hatred

resolvedPresentation.description: Reveal the Buddha's first awakened power against a true chaos enemy. The world sees that the Awakened One has not yet reached release.
resolvedPresentation.title: Show the Powers

resolvedPresentation.description: Build offices that process petitions without political theatre.
resolvedPresentation.title: Silent Offices

resolvedPresentation.description: Give the concentration vows a public place in the focus route. The Realm begins turning meditation from private practice into a state requirement.
resolvedPresentation.title: Sit Beneath Prayer Flags

resolvedPresentation.description: Turn support stores and mountain clinics toward field relief, stability, and compassion, with no ordinary militarization.
resolvedPresentation.title: Snowline Clinics

resolvedPresentation.description: The refugee lines continue as the Arhats separate useful labor, protected families, and cases the Realm says cannot be saved by open shelter alone.
resolvedPresentation.title: Sort the Worthy from the Broken

resolvedPresentation.description: Open the sanctuary logistics system to compact relief and threatened roads beyond the Realm.
resolvedPresentation.title: Storehouses for the World

resolvedPresentation.description: Keep the teaching route open while chaos, world-end pressure, or a chaos war makes every sermon a crisis act.
resolvedPresentation.title: Teach under Bombardment

resolvedPresentation.description: Let the Realm arrange its offices around the Buddha who no longer fits the shape of a ruler.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Awakened One

resolvedPresentation.description: Require every bureau near the seat to reckon with the stillness it claims to serve.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Third Quiet

resolvedPresentation.description: Let doctrine govern beyond any single human hesitation.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Throne Without a Body

resolvedPresentation.description: Keep the strongest public sign for a world-collapse crisis or a proven awakened display against chaos.
resolvedPresentation.title: Touch the Sun and Moon

resolvedPresentation.description: Build houses where vows, petitions, and foreign reports can be carried between languages without becoming ordinary propaganda.
resolvedPresentation.title: Translation Houses

resolvedPresentation.description: Bind shelters, detachments, and guardian fire into a last-pass defense against chaos pressure.
resolvedPresentation.title: The Unbroken Pass

resolvedPresentation.description: Train relief columns to move unseen among chaos enemies, leaving ordinary countries beyond the power's reach.
resolvedPresentation.title: Vanishing from Sight

resolvedPresentation.description: Review the first district where silence may mean peace or fear.
resolvedPresentation.title: A Village without Petitions

resolvedPresentation.description: Bind the Mandate against world-ending doctrine.
resolvedPresentation.title: Vow Against Annihilation

resolvedPresentation.description: Organize troops whose oaths bind them to protection before conquest. The focus creates an elite Vow-Keeper Mountaineer template, spawns six equipped mountain divisions, and adds major manpower, army experience, and doctrine discounts.
resolvedPresentation.title: Vow-Keeper Regiments

resolvedPresentation.description: The Realm extends protection claims into Sichuan, Qinghai, Gansu, Yunnan, Ningxia, Suiyuan, Shaanbei, and Urumqi.
resolvedPresentation.title: Western Chinese Frontier

resolvedPresentation.description: Send peacekeepers and relief columns where state failure keeps the wheel turning.
resolvedPresentation.title: White Flags on Foreign Roads

resolvedPresentation.description: Ask taught countries and Mandala members to stand with the Realm as it approaches its final doctrine.
resolvedPresentation.title: Witnesses Gather

resolvedPresentation.description: Ask taught countries, compact members, and Mandala offices to preserve what remained after Final Silence.
resolvedPresentation.title: Witnesses Guard the Memory

resolvedPresentation.description: Only under extreme chaos does the Realm ask larger frontiers to submit. This is imperial Mandala logic. Final Silence is a separate nuclear doctrine.
resolvedPresentation.title: The World Is Asked to Kneel

resolvedPresentation.description: The Realm sees foreign suffering as one wound. Its envoys carry this teaching abroad while the Arhats prepare a harsher answer to war.
resolvedPresentation.title: The World Is Marked as a Wound

resolvedPresentation.description: Continue aid and mediation without claiming the world can be solved.
resolvedPresentation.title: The World Still Burns
